result.stdout:
klint-rs — shadow Rust architecture engine

Usage: klint-rs [--config <dir>] [--json] [--hook] [--version]
       klint-rs stats [--config <dir>]
       klint-rs install-skill [--agents <list>] [--symlink | --copy] [--force]

  --hook           count this run as an agent hook run in klint stats
  stats            print runs and errors prevented, in total and per rule, from
                   .klint/stats.json (set KLINT_NO_STATS=1 to stop recording)

  install-skill    install the embedded klint-rules skill into agent config directories
                   Asks which agents and how to store the skill when run on a
                   terminal without --agents/--symlink/--copy.
                   --agents <list>  comma-separated: claude, codex, copilot, cursor, opencode (default: all)
                   --symlink        one skill in .agents/skills, others symlink to it (default)
                   --copy           an independent copy in every agent directory
                   --force          replace a skill directory klint did not install
